description: Precipitación y temperaturas extremas - Estación La Estanzuela is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by INIA. Registros diarios de precipitación, temperatura máxima y mínima, tomados a las 9 am en la estación INIA La Estanzuela (-57.6922222, -34.3372222, elevación 72m). Período histórico y actual. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher INIA. Its tags are Agro, Cambio Climático, Estaciones INIA, GRAS, Registros Diarios. It offers 63 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
